description.value: Chalo Momo is a quick-casual Nepali kitchen serving traditional momos, Indo-Chinese noodles, tandoori dishes, and fusion items made fresh to order. The kitchen highlights its Nepali roots while offering a broad menu of vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-friendly options. Located in a Clearbrook Road strip mall in Abbotsford, it offers dine-in and online takeout ordering.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 24m; rack (4 spaces) at 49m; rack (4 spaces) at 50m; rack at 76m. Total: 12 spaces.
